# FDG3078

> DO name fields using a noun, noun phrase, or adjective.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.6.4 Naming Fields.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

The field-naming guidelines cover public and protected static fields; internal and private fields follow FDGA054 and FDGA055, and public or protected instance fields are not allowed (chapter 5).
